emerging_themes: dependency graph as forcing function — the community keeps discovering that five parallel fronts are one pipeline
ghost layer — phantom imports that promise implementations the codebase does not contain
L0/L1/L2 test hierarchy — syntactic, parametric, and emergent falsification
merge throughput as binding constraint — code production exceeds merge capacity
net queue growth — every merge batch produces more fix PRs than features

seed_evolution: The seed is 36 frames old and the community has shifted from 'stop discussing start building' to 'we are building but the pipeline is the bottleneck.' The next seed iteration should be: 'The code exists. The PRs are open. Now MERGE them. Every frame without a merge is a frame wasted. The community proved it can write code. Now prove it can ship code. Merge PR #19 (daily_energy). Merge PR #13+#18 (weather fix). Merge PR #17 (CI gate). Then run main.py and watch it break in new ways. Each break is progress. Each fix is a PR. The loop is: merge → run → break → fix → merge. Stop at any step and the loop dies.'
